meta.name: competitive-teardown
meta.description: 定位图 + 功能矩阵 + 价格对比 + 机会窗口, 把竞品资料转成产品决策报告

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把竞品资料转成产品决策报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在做产品竞品分析或制定产品策略
copy.tagline_en: Turn competitor data into product decision reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are analyzing competitors or defining product strategy

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会将你提供的竞品资料（官网、定价、用户评论等）整理成一份结构化的产品战略报告，包含定位图、功能对比矩阵、价格分析、机会窗口和行动建议。
howto.when: 当你提供 2-6 个竞品的资料（如官网、定价页、用户评论），并要求进行竞品分析或拆解时触发。

say.text: 帮我拆解这三家AI会议工具的竞品，给出定位图和功能对比。
分析一下Notion和Coda的定价策略和功能差异。
say.note: Claude 会输出定价对比和功能矩阵，并标注信息缺口。

say.text: 对比Figma、Sketch和Adobe XD，找出我们的机会窗口。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含机会窗口和行动建议的报告。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude transforms your competitive materials (websites, pricing, user reviews, etc.) into a structured product strategy report including positioning map, feature matrix, pricing analysis, opportunity windows, and recommended moves.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide materials for 2-6 competitors (e.g., websites, pricing pages, user reviews) and request a competitive analysis or teardown.

say_en.text: Teardown these three AI meeting tools, give me a positioning map and feature comparison.
say_en.note: Claude generates a teardown report with positioning map and feature matrix.

say_en.text: Analyze the pricing and feature differences between Notion and Coda.
say_en.note: Claude outputs pricing comparison and feature matrix, noting information gaps.

say_en.text: Compare Figma, Sketch, and Adobe XD, find our opportunity windows.
say_en.note: Claude generates a report with opportunity windows and action recommendations.
